cakemonu.settings.title: CakeMonu: UMM ability icons
cakemonu.settings.help: Switch an ability on to give its icon its own place on the HUD. Move and resize it with Edit HUD (CakeUI). The rest stay in UMM's bar.
cakemonu.settings.editHud.tip: Opens CakeUI's HUD editor: drag an icon to move it, drag its corner or scroll to resize it.
cakemonu.settings.editHud.noCakeUI: Needs CakeUI 0.3.0 or newer. Without it, icons with their own place stay where CakeMonu put them (next to UMM's bar).
cakemonu.settings.none: No abilities yet: UMM learns them on Monumenta once you have a class.
cakemonu.settings.barOff: UMM's ability display is switched off in UMM's settings, so no icons are shown.
cakemonu.settings.noUmm: The Unofficial Monumenta Mod isn't installed.
cakemonu.settings.unsupported: This Unofficial Monumenta Mod version (%s) isn't supported yet: CakeMonu leaves its ability bar as it is.
